A new political alliance is taking shape in Uttar Pradesh ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections. AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi and Azad Samaj Party leader Chandrashekhar Azad have announced the Samajik Parivartan Morcha, seeking to reshape the state's electoral equations.
